name: @payswap/rails
description: Real rail adapters and reconciliation connectors (Work Order W1-005): fiat payment-intent rail, mobile-money rail, Ethereum JSON-RPC crypto rail (real public endpoint), ECB reference FX source (real public feed), webhook-loss reconciliation connectors consuming @payswap/settlement, and incident/outage handling. No simulated settlement: a rail whose provider is unreachable or lacks credentials reports UNKNOWN availability with provenance (INV-C01/C02) and fails closed (INV-NC04).
